author: I_am_banway
body:
Well, here goes nothing guys.
First map made ever! It is a smaller Team DeathMatch for the Nebula servers.
There are infinity bows and additional items that are rewards in the center.

https://www.mediafire.com/?hr374hn2ad5akcf
That's the link to download the map and

This is the album of screenies of the map!

http://imgur.com/a/qQVvo


Please consider this map senpai!
Banway/Le Wild Tato!

Edit: I dedicate this map to StormzInvader, Ever your bright and awesome personality will be missed dearly from cacalmarin. Good Luck man!

2nd edit: Thanks to fellow clan member and mate Jozz for the YML! Ty M8

replies.body: Not bad for a first map. But I think it could be bigger, more space to pvp and less void.

replies.author: Ingigo
replies.body: Good First Map! For improvements, I believe that the middle island should be bigger and the void space between the spawn should be smaller. I also believe that stone looks plain and that it could be replaced with different blocks which can improve the appearance of the map.
